parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, typically made of metal for durability and flexibility.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain the position of the frame on the face.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal for strength and flexibility.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and balance, resting on the user's right ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around the hinge joint to fold or unfold, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame that holds the lenses and the lenses themselves.
parts.Functional_description: The frame supports the lenses and connects to the legs, while the lenses correct or protect vision.
parts.Movement_description: This part is static and does not move; it serves as the central structure connecting both legs.
